content.heading: Other orders
content.text: Save as otherwise expressly provided, no appeal shall lie from any order made by a Court in the exercise of its original or appellate jurisdiction; but, where a decree is appealed from, any error, defect or irregularity in any order, affecting the decision of the case, may be set forth as a ground of objection in the memorandum of appeal. Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1), where any order is made under section 35B, no such order or any part of it shall be questioned except on an appeal from the final decree.
